description:
CadenzaFlow Identity Provider Plugin for Keycloak. Fork of
    cibseven-keycloak (the maintained continuation of the EOL
    camunda-platform-7-keycloak community plugin), re-namespaced to
    org.cadenzaflow. Two dependency lines: the primary artifact keeps
    the upstream spring-web 6 / httpclient5 code (Java 17 - Run, Spring Boot
    starter, jakarta); the -java11 artifact ports the HTTP wiring to
    spring-web 5.3 / httpclient 4 for the javax Tomcat distribution (JDK 11).
